messages:
Iris (PM): quick: prepping release notes + internal announce for v2.0.1 tomorrow 14:00 PDT. Primary changes: routing telemetry toggles and a pin on model v2-alpha in dedicated pools. Need pin owner, short customer blurb, and explicit rollback gates here. cc @here :hourglass_flowing_sand

Troy (Eng): canary plan: 6% to dedicated pool in us-west-2 for 20m, monitor redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, and obs.rpc.queue_depth. Auto-rollback if errors >1.5% sustained 5m or queue_depth > 200 for 10m. Will attach exact thresholds into the deploy config.

Aaron (Ops): Ops volunteers pin ownership during rollout. Rationale: quick pin flips required for dedicated pool changes. We'll run final smoke at T-8m.

Lily (Docs): drafting internal RN + customer blurb. Customer line suggestion: "v2.0.1: stability and telemetry improvements; no API changes." Internal RN will call out pin and rollback runway.

Iris (PM): nice. Mira on oncall?

Mira (Oncall): Mira + Sam on watch. runbook: http://go/runbooks/pin-rollout-rollback. will monitor alerts and escalate per thresholds.

Troy (Eng): deploy command queued; starting canary at 21:05 UTC (14:05 PDT).

```
/deploy release/v2.0.1 --canary=6% --duration=20m --region=us-west-2 --pool=dedicated
```

deploy-bot: queued deploy ffa12e. canary scheduled 21:05 UTC. monitors: redwood.runtime.p95, redwood.errors.rate, obs.rpc.queue_depth.

deploy-bot: canary started at 21:05 UTC. reporting window open.

Mira (Oncall): initial readouts look ok: p95 baseline, errors 0.1%, queue_depth ~65.

Troy (Eng): enabling extra telemetry flags for 10m to capture routing traces.

deploy-bot: canary complete at 21:25 UTC — preliminary metrics OK. ready to promote to 100% in 5m unless veto posted.

Iris (PM): no product veto. Promote.

deploy-bot: promoted to 100% at 21:31 UTC. release tag: v2.0.1. summary: p95 +3% vs baseline, errors 0.4%, queue_depth nominal. :tada:

Lily (Docs): RN draft posted here for quick signoff: "v2.0.1 — telemetry and routing stability tweaks; pinned v2-alpha in dedicated pools for controlled rollout. No API changes; ops-owned rollout; oncall observed minor p95 increase within acceptable bounds." Please comment if edits.

Aaron (Ops): pin owner confirmed (Ops). Rationale: ensure we can flip dedicated pool routing without impacting public tiers.

Mira (Oncall): oncall confirmed no follow-on alerts. marking as stable.

Iris (PM): Lily please post internal announce to #eng-all and schedule customer blurb for morning. Closing after posts.

Lily (Docs): posted internal announce at 22:02 UTC in #eng-all and scheduled customer blurb for 09:00 PT. Closing thread."
